title: 1989 AMC 8 Problem 6
statement: If the markings on the number line shown are equally spaced, what is the number \(y?\)

solutions.text:
From \(0\) to \(20\) there are \(5\) equal spaces, so each space is \(\frac{20}{5} = 4.\)

The mark labeled \(y\) is \(3\) spaces from \(0,\) so \(y = 3 \times 4 = 12.\)

Thus, the correct answer is C .
hints: Count how many equal spaces lie between \(0\) and \(20\)
There are \(5\) spaces from \(0\) to \(20,\) so each space is \(\frac{20}{5} = 4;\) then count the spaces up to \(y\)
